    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Currency = 'CZK' THEN t.Amount ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Difference
FROM transactions t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

ROUND(AVG(bond_type = '-'), 2) AS avg_single_bonded_carcinogens
FROM 
(SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM 
molecule m1, 
molecule m2, 
bond b1, 
bond b2, 
bond_type bt ON b1.molecule_id = b2.molecule_id 
WHERE bt = '-' GROUP BY b1.molecule_id)
GROUP BY bond_type
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
```
